sectionIntro: My 18 Roses, Candles, Shots, Bills, Bags, Makeups, and Footwears—see the full list below.

categories.name: Roses
categories.title: Roses
categories.description:
For my 18 Roses, I have chosen gentlemen who mean a lot to me to join me for this celebration.

When your group is called, we'll share a dance and present a rose to mark this milestone together.

Thank you for being part of my debut story—I can't wait to celebrate with you.

categories.name: Candles
categories.title: Candles
categories.description:
For my 18 Candles, I have chosen each of you because your friendship has meant the world to me.

When you are called, please light a candle with me and share a favorite memory or a wish for my future.

Thank you for being with me through every chapter—I'm so grateful to celebrate this moment with you.

categories.name: Shots
categories.title: Shots
categories.description:
For my 18 Shots, thank you for standing with me as I toast to this new chapter.

When your name is called, join me for a celebratory shot and a cheer to the years ahead.

I'm grateful you're part of my debut night.

categories.name: Bills
categories.title: Bills
categories.description:
For my 18 Bills, thank you for your generosity and for blessing this milestone with me.

Your presence and support mean more than words can say.

categories.name: Bags
categories.title: Bags
categories.description:
For my 18 Bags, each of you holds a special place in my heart—thank you for walking this journey with me.

I'm excited to share this celebration with you.

categories.name: Makeups
categories.title: Makeups
categories.description:
For my 18 Makeups, thank you for helping me shine on one of the most important nights of my life.

Your talent and care mean the world to me.

categories.name: Footwears
categories.title: Footwears
categories.description:
For my 18 Footwears, thank you for stepping into this celebration with me—literally and figuratively.

I'm so glad you're part of my debut.
